d: Nisha bhagat maut mamle men jharkhand sarkar ne bara phaisla liya hai. mukhyamantri hemant soren ne is mamle ki janch CBI se karane ka aadesh diya hai. is phaisle ke bad ab mamle ki janch kendriy janch byuro (CBI) karegi. nisha bhagat ki maut ke bad se hi mamle ko lekar kaee saval uth rahe the. parijnon aur vibhinn sangathnon ki or se nishpaksh janch ki mang ki ja rahi thi. ab CBI janch ke aadesh ke bad is pure mamle se jure kaee aham pahluon ke samne aane ki ummid hai. aakhir nisha bhagat ki maut ke pichhe kya vajah thi? kaun-kaun se saval ab bhi ansuljhe hain? janie is riport men puri…
